page.layout: One page of text, single column; heading block at top in italic capitals; a large woodcut initial at the start of the paragraph; signature mark and catchword-line at the foot. No margin notes. Scan also shows a digitiser's footer (not transcribed) and show-through at the left edge (not transcribed).

main_text.head: SERENISSIMO ET POTENTISSIMO PRINCIPI ac Domino, D. MAXIMILIANO, Regi Bohemiae & Hungariae: Archiduci Austriae, Burgundiae, Silesiae, &c. Domino suo clementissimo S. D:
main_text.p: ADmonet me, Serenissime Rex, hoc tempus, quo festum S. Michaelis celebratur, ut de conditione, custodia, atque defensione castorum angelorum, per quos Deus coetum suum ab omnibus calamitatibus in hac vita tueri vult, pauca quaedam dicere proposuerim. Quibus deinde addam, quo modo sanctos quoque ad nos possimus angelos allicere; ut fidelem nostri curam gerant, ab omnibusque periculis tueantur: denique, qua id ratione fiat, ut boni saepe custodis loco, malus homini adiungatur & attribuatur genius.
Initio autem angelos esse, nemini pio sanaeque mentis dubium est. Id enim & sacra

page.notes: The initial "A" is a large woodcut initial; it is joined to the word as "ADmonet". The heading is set in italic capitals with roman interior lines. Some words in the italic heading and in the first line are slightly blurred; "Hurgariae" in the heading is read as printed "Hungariae" only where clear. The word "tueantur" ends with a printed colon-like mark, rendered as printed. Catchword "& sacra" and signature mark read from the foot line.
